policy: Curated cross-passage comparisons, not exhaustive coding, independent adjudication, population prevalence or demonstrated communication benefit. Contrasts are boundary cases, not matched experimental controls.

cards.title: Move from a specific account to a broader point
cards.mechanism: A narrated person, encounter or event supplies a concrete anchor before a broader interpretation or appeal.

supports.reason: A narrated upbringing is contrasted with later encounters and followed by a general statement that people can change. Reported experiences and feelings remain attributed; one narrative does not prove the general proposition.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to Katy Perry; transcript mentions an award, thanks and dedication. Event identity and audience response are not independently verified.

supports.reason: A narrated biography is used to present a person's rise as an illustration of national possibility. This is argument structure, not evidence that the biography proves a universal opportunity claim.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an India address to Donald Trump; greeting, named host and national friendship language support ceremonial-address context. Current officeholding and source statistics are not asserted.

supports.reason: The speaker uses an origin-and-achievement account to encourage an audience, combining uncertainty about personal completion with direct persistence advice. One case does not establish universal capability or career causality.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to Rashmika Mandanna; transcript mentions an event audience and personal reflection. Identity and reported personal history are unverified.

supports.reason: A prompt about a visit elicits reported conversations with bereaved people, a particular encounter and a statement that large historical issues are personal. Their reported feelings are attributed accounts, not direct psychological observations.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata names Obama and McRaven; a moderator-like question and marked turn changes support an interview format. Individual turn attribution and reported encounters are not independently verified.

contrasts.reason: A narrated move and ambition lead into accounts of a manager, agents, family and a training setting. The sequence connects biography to acknowledgments; factual details and precise causality remain unverified.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes the address to Keanu Reeves; transcript thanks collaborators and references a ceremony at a movie theater. Exact event and turn identities are not independently verified.

contrasts.reason: The speaker reports asking recruiters to assess engineering ability with a language-compatible panel, then reports job selections. The story includes changing evaluation access as well as presentation training, so it does not isolate the training's effect.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to R. Madhavan; transcript addresses students and describes teaching interview preparation. Source identity and real outcomes are unverified.

cards.limit: An acknowledgment chain need not generalize; a story's causal conclusion may also depend on access, selection or other changes. An example can illustrate without proving.
cards.exercise: Mark the exact transition from event to general claim. Write down what additional evidence the general claim needs.
cards.test: Compare complete episodes with and without explicit transitions, matched on genre and topic; independently rate whether listeners can distinguish example from conclusion.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers

cards.title: The same repeated form can do different jobs
cards.mechanism: Repeated stems organize units, but the units may be preferences, gratitude, hypotheses or metaphorical appeals.

supports.reason: A question elicits a repeated-stem list of tastes, commitments, claims and imagined rules. Many uses of belief language do not merely weaken factual certainty.
supports.format_evidence: Source metadata identifies a film scene; transcript has multi-party dialogue but incomplete turn attribution.

supports.reason: Thanks move from a named collaborator to the venue and supporting organization. Repetition marks acknowledgment, not automatically uncertainty or a request for behavior.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes the address to Keanu Reeves; transcript thanks collaborators and references a ceremony at a movie theater. Exact event and turn identities are not independently verified.

supports.reason: Repeated possibility markers introduce alternative explanations for collective silence. These are the speaker's hypotheses about experience, not directly observed mental states of women or the audience.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes the campaign-address excerpt to Michelle Obama; the source explicitly locates its discussion in 2016. This review does not assert current political status or verify allegations.

supports.reason: A local welcome leads into repeated pen-and-story language contrasting opposing narratives with an alternative. Name and pen/PIN inconsistencies are retained; repetition is interpreted in context rather than as verified word-perfect delivery.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a rally upload featuring Kelly and Beyoncé. The transcript suggests multiple voices but does not reliably label every turn; speaker boundaries remain tentative.

contrasts.reason: Repeated choice imperatives list conventional goals and possessions, increasingly framed negatively. Isolating the opening would hide the later repudiation.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Trainspotting excerpt; first-person narration and drug references are fictional discourse, not performer biography or advice.

contrasts.reason: A question and first-person refusal reject the listed path, followed by a drug reference offered as an alternative in the narration. The local structure subverts the apparent advice; it is not endorsed lifestyle or substance-use guidance.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Trainspotting excerpt; first-person narration and drug references are fictional discourse, not performer biography or advice.

cards.limit: Later rejection can invert an apparent imperative. Counts of repeated words do not establish confidence, persuasion or a stable function.
cards.exercise: Label the job of each repeated clause and inspect the ending before interpreting the opening.
cards.test: Annotate repetition spans and later reversals before testing delivery. Compare within-function examples rather than pooling all repeated phrases.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers

cards.title: Return to an earlier anchor
cards.mechanism: A later section explicitly revisits an image, example, analogy or topic used earlier, linking separated parts of an episode.

supports.reason: The close revisits an image of childhood teaching introduced earlier, linking the ending to the personal-change account. Whether listeners noticed or benefited from this return is not measured.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to Katy Perry; transcript mentions an award, thanks and dedication. Event identity and audience response are not independently verified.

supports.reason: An explicit return to friendship introduces another narrated travel account and an unfinished evaluation at the end of the inspected window. This next episode is not fully reviewed.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a political address to Kamala Harris; transcript contains autobiographical references and audience markers. Current officeholding and event authenticity are not independently verified.

supports.reason: The drink is tasted and evaluated with a price qualification; music/applause markers precede a question about conversational silence. Those markers and the topic of silence do not establish an acoustic pause's duration or cause.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Pulp Fiction restaurant scene. Multi-party scripted dialogue and service exchanges are apparent in text, but per-turn identity and actual sound are not independently verified.

supports.reason: The account returns to the particular young person before expanding to mutual obligation; a new question then begins. Recalled facial expression is part of narration, not a present visual observation or proof of audience emotion.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata names Obama and McRaven; a moderator-like question and marked turn changes support an interview format. Individual turn attribution and reported encounters are not independently verified.

contrasts.reason: The response acknowledges technical difficulty, then gives a civilizational mission and one company's role as an example. This changes from engineering mechanics to purpose; it does not by itself establish avoidance or a complete answer.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an interview to Elon Musk; the questioner addresses Elon and the exchange mentions Davos. Questioner identity and event authenticity are not independently verified.

cards.limit: A new mission-level answer is not necessarily a return to an earlier anchor. Topic overlap alone is insufficient; establish both linked spans. No memory benefit has been measured.
cards.exercise: Draw a link between the earlier anchor and its return, then explain what new role it plays.
cards.test: Verify complete anchor/return boundaries and compare audience recall with a matched version lacking the return; no such experiment has been run.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers

cards.title: Change the frame of a claim or choice
cards.mechanism: The passage changes what a credential, situation, opponent or decision is taken to mean, then develops consequences under that frame.

supports.reason: A metaphor for a narrow major contrasts with a multidisciplinary list. The diploma is then reframed as permission to acknowledge further learning, not literally redefined as a credential.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a speech to Neil deGrasse Tyson; transcript directly addresses graduates and names a class year. Format is transcript/metadata-supported, not independently verified.

supports.reason: The source claims understanding requires seeing for oneself, then presents two choices with narrated consequences and a truth assurance. This is a constrained fictional choice frame; exclusivity, freedom of choice and factual promises are not independently established.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Matrix scene. Fictional explanation and choice framing are analyzed without endorsing the claims or inferring performer belief.

supports.reason: A sentence reverses the subject/object relationship between a person and an institution, then contrasts an alternative and requests another term. The reversal compresses the thesis without independently proving the attributed institutional change.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to Ivanka Trump; familial references and campaign advocacy support a political-address interpretation without independently verifying claims or current offices.

contrasts.reason: The source recategorizes adversaries as neighbors or family, assigns responsibility to a third party and calls for violence to be redirected. This is a critical description of a fictional mobilization argument, not a nonviolent de-escalation technique or recommendation.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Hunger Games scene. Transcript contains weapon commands and a fictional conflict; speaker turns and visual events are unverified.

contrasts.reason: The speaker asks whether reform is substantive or merely symbolic, then presents a concrete gate-and-wall demand to a named addressee as an unmistakable sign. The conditional sequence translates values into a requested act, but does not establish that the act is a sufficient test of those values.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a historical address by Ronald Reagan. The source's historical claims and attributed offices are not independently verified or asserted as current.

cards.limit: A clear frame can omit alternatives, advocate harm or propose an inadequate test of values. Structural coherence is not truth, ethics or effectiveness.
cards.exercise: Restate the frame neutrally and list alternatives or assumptions it leaves out. Do not rehearse harmful mobilization appeals.
cards.test: Independently assess frame accuracy, alternatives and target action before evaluating comprehension. Separate normative validity from audience agreement.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers

cards.title: Questions organize different kinds of response
cards.mechanism: Questions can allocate a turn, obtain a detail, challenge a premise or request an explanation; evaluate the response against that particular job.

supports.reason: A question about development is followed by historical, price and experience assertions, a referral-like turn and a move to the second point. Garbled figures are not repaired; no present-day pricing, policy status or implementation is inferred.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a parliamentary speech to Sudha Murthy. Introductory third-person promotional narration precedes an address to a chair; turn labels are incomplete and exact narrator identity is unverified.

supports.reason: Ordering and clarification questions shift into an evaluative challenge about a drink's price. Questions perform transaction management and stance, not one generic audience-engagement function.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Pulp Fiction restaurant scene. Multi-party scripted dialogue and service exchanges are apparent in text, but per-turn identity and actual sound are not independently verified.

supports.reason: The questioner lists technology domains and asks what they share from an engineering standpoint. This establishes the requested level of explanation rather than a general invitation to speak.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an interview to Elon Musk; the questioner addresses Elon and the exchange mentions Davos. Questioner identity and event authenticity are not independently verified.

supports.reason: The response acknowledges technical difficulty, then gives a civilizational mission and one company's role as an example. This changes from engineering mechanics to purpose; it does not by itself establish avoidance or a complete answer.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an interview to Elon Musk; the questioner addresses Elon and the exchange mentions Davos. Questioner identity and event authenticity are not independently verified.

supports.reason: A prompt about difficult roles leads into qualifications about performance conventions, then distinguishes technical challenge from extreme hardship and suggests ordinary roles can be harder. This is a stated assessment, not a measured ranking of acting difficulty.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata names Brad Pitt and SRK; transcript explicitly labels an interviewer and two participants, though label accuracy and delivery remain unverified.

contrasts.reason: A secondhand anecdote with quoted dialogue leads into a moral standard for leadership. The child's quoted forecast is reported speech, not the speaker's calibrated prediction or proof of a legal eligibility rule.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes the campaign-address excerpt to Michelle Obama; the source explicitly locates its discussion in 2016. This review does not assert current political status or verify allegations.

contrasts.reason: A request for a joke meets reluctance; reassurance about not laughing is interpreted as a prediction that the joke will fail. The next turn rejects that meaning. This is a local ambiguity-and-repair sequence, not measured embarrassment or proof of intended delivery.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata identifies a Pulp Fiction restaurant scene. Multi-party scripted dialogue and service exchanges are apparent in text, but per-turn identity and actual sound are not independently verified.

cards.limit: A quoted question is not a current audience prompt. A response may supply purpose instead of mechanics, and an ambiguous reassurance may require repair.
cards.exercise: Write the requested information beside what the answer actually supplies; identify any change of level or repair.
cards.test: Use independently labelled turns and compare response relevance at mechanism, purpose, evidence and procedure levels. Audio is needed for uncertain turn boundaries.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers

cards.title: Preserve caveats when a story claims an outcome
cards.mechanism: A speaker connects preceding words, actions or experiences to a reported result; the story may omit alternatives or acknowledge chance.

supports.reason: The speaker reports asking recruiters to assess engineering ability with a language-compatible panel, then reports job selections. The story includes changing evaluation access as well as presentation training, so it does not isolate the training's effect.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to R. Madhavan; transcript addresses students and describes teaching interview preparation. Source identity and real outcomes are unverified.

supports.reason: Broad claims about verbal influence lead into two reported parent-child exchanges with different phrasing and outcomes. The account does not control timing or other changes; alleged child pride or intention remains the narrator's interpretation.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a speech to Mohammed Qahtani; contest salutations and a later winner introduction support event boundaries. Actual award status and delivery are not independently verified.

supports.reason: A question about rehearsal elicits a story of substantial practice with no reported improvement and a claimed decision to stop rehearsing. It is not controlled evidence that practice fails or advice to avoid preparation.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata names Brad Pitt and SRK; transcript explicitly labels an interviewer and two participants, though label accuracy and delivery remain unverified.

supports.reason: An imagined graduate-school path contrasts with the reported career. The narrative acknowledges lack of foresight and luck alongside passion and openness. This qualifies a deterministic success explanation but still does not identify a causal effect.
supports.format_evidence: Metadata attributes an address to Sundar Pichai; the transcript addresses a graduating class and contains possible embedded image-caption text. Exact source format and editorial contamination require verification.

contrasts.reason: The source offers health-related arguments and then explicitly says they were made up. They must not be extracted as medical facts. Reported friends' belief or behavior is also unverified, not an experimental persuasion result.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a speech to Mohammed Qahtani; contest salutations and a later winner introduction support event boundaries. Actual award status and delivery are not independently verified.

contrasts.reason: A described document inspection, percentages and a small set of examples lead to an invitation to imagine a larger hidden pattern. No representative sampling design is supplied, so the transcript does not justify quantitative extrapolation. Garbled names are not resolved or repeated as verified identities.
contrasts.format_evidence: Metadata attributes a legislative address to Ro Khanna; the transcript addresses a speaker/chair. Identity, legal requirements and allegations remain unverified.

cards.limit: These are evidence-quality comparisons, not a recommended persuasive tactic. Fabricated premises and unrepresentative extrapolation are not effectiveness evidence.
cards.exercise: List every changed condition, the counterfactual and any luck caveat. Separate reported outcome from independently measured outcome.
cards.test: Seek independent outcome records, comparison cases and alternative explanations. Self-report, awards and testimonials are not causal validation.
cards.speaker_recurrence: not established; videos are not independent speakers
